tldr: The matched frontier is for the observed-law exponential-tilt functional on the triangular restricted class \(\mathcal M_n(b,c)\). This class is a strict specialization of Schindl--Shen--Kennedy's general continuous-exposure setup: known uniform \(n\)-cell adjustment, density and mean envelopes, \(t=n^b\), and a public near-common-normalizer radius are imposed here. Root risk and honest connected-interval length both have order \(n^{-\gamma(b,c)}\), where \(\gamma(b,c)=\max_{1\leq j\leq K}\min\{jc,(1-jb)/2\}\) and \(K=\lceil1/b\rceil-1\), with no logarithmic factor. Total observable constructions attain these orders at every specified finite sample size, and same-class converses retain all original records. A fixed radius gives positive limiting precision floors; every fixed \(c>0\) restores consistency and shrinking honest length. The inherited causal interpretation holds only for completions satisfying Proposition 1. The advertising-and-contribution benchmark is prospective.
gap: Continuous-tilt information bounds and sparse binary-cell causal bounds do not determine original-record precision when exposure concentration and relative normalizer heterogeneity change together at one record per cell on average.
fill: Open-ended Question 1 asks for explicit every-sample-size risk and honest-length rates over exactly that primitive class. Theorems and lemmas separate the all-class covariance certificate from full-original-law mixture comparison, fixed-count transfer, and target concentration.
